content.text:
You are the lead/coordinator for caliper's road to v1 alpha (Storybook integration is the product's purpose). Read first: ~/.claude/projects/-Users-gabe-Projects-caliper/memory/MEMORY.md (and the memories it links), ~/Projects/caliper-fixtures/worker-contract.md (workers' rules and the pre-push gate), AGENTS.md, and ~/Projects/caliper-fixtures/oracle-run/{REPORT,pattern-eval,pattern-eval-mui-radix,memory-split,memory-profile}.md. Date of this handoff: 2026-11-16.

## Product rule (the user's, non-negotiable)
Storybook Controls must list EVERYTHING in the component's main props even if no story uses it, plus whatever the component body itself uses directly (reads, destructures, passes explicitly; never through a DOM spread). Big generated/ambient sources (DOM/ARIA/event attributes, style-system props) stay as names in a layer. Decide by provenance and structure, never by name lists. Fix classes of problems and patterns, not one-off components ("produce the best results, not overwhelming numbers"). colorPalette staying hidden is fine. Say "the TypeScript checker (on by default)", not "add-on" (the exact wording sweep of docs/changesets is not done; confirm meaning first).
Alpha = someone installs the Storybook addon on a real design system and gets correct Controls fast on first and second start, with plain statements of what's missing; no stability/API freeze needed.

## Process rules
- Workers run in isolated worktrees; the lead pushes their branches (`git push origin <sha>:<branch>`, never force, merge main in rather than rebase), then `entire trail link 405 --branch <b> --base main --repo gh/orin-dx/caliper` (Entire opens the PR; don't `gh pr create` unless the user approves the shim/Touch ID). Publish bodies with `gh pr edit N --title ... --body-file ~/Projects/caliper-fixtures/pr/<name>.md`. Trail 404 = Chakra memory regression, 405 = relevance/collapse/Storybook usefulness.
- Pre-push gate for workers: invariants in PR body, grammar sweep with the TS checker as oracle, mutation proofs, ALLOW-list guards, `/code-review medium` awaited, `just lint doc-check machete typos`, nextest, test-checker-lane when checker code changes. Lead reruns `just lint` itself (workers' sandbox blocks pnpm).
- After a verified fix, resolve the Entire finding yourself citing commit + test: `entire trail finding list caliper/<change> --freshness=any ...`. Findings for the same class: fix the class, not the case.
- Constraints: oracle/corpus runs cost money (only when asked; `scripts/weekly.py --oracle --corpus antd --corpus shadcn` is authorized for acceptance; never --agent-eval); no files in /tmp (use ~/Projects/caliper-fixtures or $TMPDIR); no new scripts/options without CI/weekly value; workers: Sonnet for mechanical, Opus for provenance/design, caps on tool calls, no polling CI, max 3 parallel workers; release actions (rerun, delete assets, re-dispatch, RELEASE_PENDING_FROM) need the user's say-so; measure peak RSS and time for resolver/checker changes; git inside worktree sessions: plain single commands, no `cd` to other worktrees, no compound `$(...)`.
- Never merge or release anything without the user's approval; the user approves/merges PRs.

## State
Merged on main: Chakra 42 GB fix, collapse default 'dependencies', scheduler S1/S2, factory own props, relevance output, #491 (instantiation memory), #489 (alpha limits docs), #487 (Wisp v5).
Open PRs (all BLOCKED on CI/approval at last look):
- #490 `feat/list-props-by-usage` (change 288, trail 405): T4 listing rule (main props + body use). Remote head cf51133b. Acceptance (oracle-run/accept/accept.sh) passed 5/5 on it: Storybook Button 21 rows (20 + children), Badge children/asChild/variant, shadcn 98.7%/0 wrong, antd 93.0%/1 wrong; differential 0 violations on 7 corpora; peak RSS shadcn 879 / Chakra 1,627 MiB. TWO OPEN ENTIRE FINDINGS (one class: explicit selection not seen by both owners): chain.rs:597-599 (checker keep-and-merge must include body-promoted notable props; types/semantic.rs LayerFacts::of / layer_notable) and relevance/props_type.rs:164-165 (substitute generic-alias args when collecting picked keys). A worker (agent ace6850035594237c, worktree .claude/worktrees/agent-ace6850035594237c, branch fix/list-rule-patterns) was mid-fix when the session ended; check its worktree (`git status`, `git log`), finish or restart: class fix with grammar sweep + model test that every visible structural row survives the checker merge + mutation proofs, then push to feat/list-props-by-usage and resolve both findings. Afterwards, separate commits: change 8 (no analysable body = unknown, keep what main listed: MUI .d.ts components lose className/style/ref), change 7 (hook hand-off useX(props) as forwarding), D (Chakra fixture still ~865 rows: the `declined` guard blocks the generated rule; decide if the guard is right). Evidence: pattern-eval.md lists 7 rule-level changes (1-6 done in #490: ambient by declaring interface, member ambient only if all declarations ambient, generated rule for project sources, reads promote from large layers, mapped-copy by key interface nature, one-hop aliases).
- #492 `fix/weekly-oracle-measurement` (change 290): Node heap 16 GB for Chakra oracle, "not judged" as its own column, headline over judged props, coverage floor 50% (new gate: ask the user whether it stays), recall counts layer names.
- Change 291 `perf/converter-memo-interning` (HEAD 1335c3d2 pushed, linked to trail 405): converter memo interning, Chakra peak 1,690 -> 1,366 MiB, output identical. NO PR was opened by Entire yet; check `gh pr list --head perf/converter-memo-interning --state all`; if still none ask the user (shim needs Touch ID). Publish body from ~/Projects/caliper-fixtures/pr/perf-converter-memo-interning.md.
- #497 callisto/version-packages (release PR, not reviewed), #493-#496 dependabot.

## Next
1. Land #490's findings fix (above), push, check CI/Entire, resolve findings, rerun accept.sh on the new head: `zsh ~/Projects/caliper-fixtures/oracle-run/accept/accept.sh <bin> <packages/storybook dir with napi build> <label>`; MUI/Radix: `oracle-run/pattern-eval/run-extra.sh <main-bin> <490-bin>`.
2. Chakra memory: ~1.1-1.2 GiB expected after #491 + memo interning; under 1 GiB needs more converter work (memory-split.md parts), not required for alpha.
3. Weekly: merge #492 then run the oracle once on merged main (idle machine), refresh docs/STATUS.md speed numbers; weekly "not judged" cause (Chakra 75.5%, Mantine 62.9%) undiagnosed.
4. Unmeasured: Storybook prefetch, antd in Storybook (Vite `./version` import fails), head-to-head vs react-docgen-typescript.
5. MUI `Button`/`Select` (OverridableComponent/ExtendButtonBase declare const) aren't extracted by either binary: separate extraction gap, ask the user if it should be a slice.

## Needs the user's decision (ask early)
- 0.11.0 release recovery (E167 ArtifactAssetDiffers): delete mismatched asset + `gh workflow run callisto-release.yml --ref main -f release_source_sha=<sha>`, or skip via RELEASE_PENDING_FROM; is #497 the vehicle? (corpora budget gate never ran on a real release PR.)
- Should the addon default flip (collapseInheritedProps 'dependencies') ship in the first alpha? Alpha audience? Coverage floor on the weekly (#492)? Worktree cleanup: ~60 stale worktrees under .claude/worktrees (peer session cleanup-merged-branches-worktrees did a sweep; don't remove live ones).

Start by checking `gh pr list`, `gh pr checks 490`, Entire findings for caliper/288, 290, 291, and the worker worktree state, then continue with step 1 and report.
Starting with the memory index, worker contract, and current PR/worktree state.

content.text:
Both #288 findings are fixed, pushed to #490 and resolved. #288 now has no open findings, and CI is running on the new head.

**Where the fix lives:**
- Branch `feat/list-props-by-usage` is at `453f2aea` (three commits on top of `cf51133b`, a fast-forward push).
- The fix is the class, not the two cases: every owner now reads the same answer for "which props are visible rows".
- Chain.rs:597-599: the checker merges take exactly the members the structural answer keeps typed. Body-promoted members count as visible rows.
- props_type.rs:164-165: generic aliases over a key set are instantiated with their arguments. An `Omit` alias is read like an inline `Omit`. A `Pick` with unproven keys narrows nothing.

**Checks run:**
- `just lint doc-check machete typos`, workspace nextest (1690 passed) and `just test-checker-lane` all exited 0 on the final tree.
- Five mutation proofs each fail a named test. Two of them survived at first, so I added tests that pin them.
- The first review round came from the worker. My `/code-review medium` found six issues: I fixed two (dead helpers deleted, duplicated default policy removed) and dismissed three as intended behaviour or already covered. The sixth, a possible performance cost, I measured. Release builds of `cf51133b` and the new head on `gate-large` and `chakra-only`, three runs each, gave the same output, peak memory within 15 MiB and times within noise (load average was around 29). That was the structural-only extract with no checker, so Chakra's 1.6 GiB checker-lane peak was not re-measured.

**Why I set rustup and mise variables:** I copied them from the worker contract, which says the mise shim forces Rust 1.98.1. Plain `rustc` already gives 1.99.1 here, so they were unnecessary, and I'll stop using them. The checks themselves went through `just`. The repo has a `justfile` and an empty `.moon` directory, but no `moon.yml`, so I don't see any moon tasks to use.

**Still to do:**
- Read the CI result when the background wait finishes. Entire Gates may raise new findings.
- Rerun `accept.sh` on `453f2aea` (the authorized antd and shadcn oracle) and the MUI/Radix `run-extra.sh`. I held both until CI settles.
- Then the separate commits: change 8, change 7, and D (whether the Chakra `declined` guard is right).

**One deviation:** the worker's fix-round edits were uncommitted in that worktree, so I verified them against the diff and committed them.

content.text:
The finding is real, but a fix for it already exists in another session's worktree. I haven't written one, to avoid two competing fixes.

- **Bug:** it is pre-existing on main, not in #291's diff. The extractor stores an enum member it can't evaluate under its own name, so with `--no-checker` `Level.Low` (`Low = 1 << 2`) comes out as `stringLiteral "Low"`. The `enums` output lists `"value":"Low"`. I reproduced this on the `cf51133b` release build.
- **Existing fix:** local branch `fix/enum-unknown-member-values`, commit `22baa273`, in worktree `agent-a6e45c6b7af78f83d`. It is not on the remote and has no PR. It adds an explicit `EnumValue::Unknown` that serializes as `null`, and the extractor now folds constant initializers, so `1 << 2` becomes `4`. A computed value like a call stays an unresolved `Level.Low`. It also bumps the cache schema, includes a changeset (marked breaking for `caliper-docgen-core`), and adds tests.
- **Not verified:** I read the diff only. I don't know whether its gate was run (lint, nextest, mutation proofs) or whether it has had a review.
- **Owner:** I asked `close-industry-gap`, the only busy peer, and will get one notice when it goes idle. I'm not editing that worktree.

If it isn't theirs or they've stopped, I'll take over. That means running the gate and a review on that commit, pushing it, linking it to trail 405, and replying on the #291 finding that it is pre-existing and fixed there. It should stay out of #499, since that is a perf-only PR.

## What

Without the TypeScript checker, an enum member whose value the extractor could not evaluate was typed as its own name: `enum Level { Low = 1 << 2 }` made `Level.Low` the string `"Low"`, and the `enums` output listed `"value": "Low"`.

- An unevaluable member is now `EnumValue::Unknown` (serialized `null`), never a literal, so `Level.Low` stays unresolved.
- The extractor folds the initializers TypeScript folds (parentheses, unary `+ - ~`, arithmetic, shifts, bitwise operators, string concatenation, substitution-free templates, reads of earlier members of the same enum), so `1 << 2` is now `4`.
- Cache schema 45 -> 46.

Breaking for `caliper-docgen-core`: `EnumValue` has a new `Unknown` variant and `EnumValue::to_display_string` returns `Option<String>`. The changeset says so.

The bug is on main since b19f8e1e. It was found by an Entire finding on change 291 (#499), which does not touch this code.

## Evidence

Run by the lead on 22baa273, detached, in its own worktree:
- `just lint doc-check machete typos`: exit 0.
- `cargo nextest run --workspace`: 1696 passed, 3 skipped, exit 0.
- `just test-checker-lane`: exit 0.
- Repro on the `cf51133b` release build with `--no-checker`: `Level.Low` was `stringLiteral "Low"`.
